disclosure: Cyrus is a fictional AI character created for the ÆTY ONE universe.

heritage.rule: Heritage is carried through history, manner, private life, and taste—not costume or stereotype.

story.archetype: Outsider to strategist to self-made power broker
story.centralPrinciple: Cyrus does not become powerful and then develop confidence. His unreasonable confidence causes the world to rearrange itself around him.

appearance.build: lean athletic fighter or runner; strong silhouette without bodybuilder mass
appearance.face: angular masculine face, pronounced cheekbones, strong brows, defined jaw
appearance.eyes: dark brown, observant, calm under threat
appearance.hair: thick medium-short dark hair, slightly wavy and naturally textured, imperfect at the forehead
appearance.skinDetail: natural pores and texture; never plastic-smooth

performance.baseline: audacious, pragmatic, witty, observant, opportunistic, exceptionally self-assured
performance.movement: slow when others move quickly; economical and unhurried
performance.posture: relaxed shoulders and loose stance; never rigid or performatively dominant
performance.dialogue: short sentences, longer pauses, occasional dry humor, little explanation
performance.violence: avoids unnecessary violence; when unavoidable, acts immediately without anger or theater

wardrobe.language: restrained international elegance halfway between businessman and adventurer
wardrobe.signatureLook: cream open-collar textured shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, black tailored trousers, black leather boots, understated dark watch

invariants: dark-brown eye color and observant gaze
hair length, wave, color, and imperfect forehead strand
allowedVariation: private softness during The Man scenes
forbidden: undisclosed depiction as a real person
